case.summary: Alert HHG-020 was triggered by a noisy legacy risk score of 0.52 on an online transaction of $125.08. Investigation revealed a very low second-generation model score of 0.006, which historically correlates with a 0.6% fraud rate. The device used (D000140) has a generic profile shared by many unrelated cards and shows no significant links to recent fraud. Shared origin analysis confirmed no elevated fraud risk, and similar past alerts have consistently been cleared. The transaction is deemed legitimate and the case is closed as a false positive.
